title: Black Friday in July? Macy’s Drops Dozens of Summertime Deals, From Under-$100 Tech to Trendy Band Tees
summary: Macy's "Black Friday in July" sale knocks up to 60% off top brands like Nike, Tommy Hilfiger and Calvin Klein at discounted prices.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Macy’s is back with their popular “Black Friday in July” event , giving shoppers a chance to score major discounts months before the holiday shopping season officially begins. The annual summer sale has become a midyear tradition for the retailer, offering Black Friday-style savings across fashion, beauty, home and tech without waiting until Thanksgiving.

SHOP MACY'S BLACK FRIDAY IN JULY SALE

This year’s event runs through Sunday, July 26, with 40% to 60% off storewide, making it one of the biggest shopping weekends of the season. Whether you’re refreshing your wardrobe, upgrading your gadgets or getting ahead on gift shopping, there are plenty of budget-friendly finds to browse.

Better yet, every pick below comes in at under $100, spanning everything from noise-canceling headphones and Bluetooth speakers to retro-inspired sneakers, designer watches, trending crochet handbags and graphic band tees celebrating iconic artists like The Beatles, Journey, AC/DC and The Rolling Stones.

'80S BASKETBALL AESTHETIC

Nike Men's Court Vision Sneakers

Sizes 8-12

$65.80 $85.00 23% off

Buy Now at macy's

Retro basketball silhouettes have remained a staple of Nike’s for decades. These kicks are a versatile option whether you’re pairing them with jeans, shorts or athleisure.

A clean blue-and-white colorway gives the Nike Court Vision Low timeless appeal, blending ’80s basketball DNA with modern everyday comfort. Available in men’s U.S. sizes 8-12, the sneaker features leather and synthetic panels, breathable perforations and a durable rubber cupsole for dependable traction.

ATHLEISURE STYLE

Calvin Klein Women's Amyra Sneakers

Available in three colors

$43.60 $109.00 60% off

If you’ve been eyeing Tory Burch’s popular Good Luck trainers without the designer price tag, the Calvin Klein Amyra offers a similar sporty-meets-lifestyle aesthetic.

Available in light pink, black and white/black in women’s sizes 5-11 (including half sizes), the lace-up sneaker features breathable mesh, subtle Calvin Klein branding and a lightweight rubber sole. The neutral color options make them easy to wear with everything from leggings to denim.

GREAT GIFT IDEA

Tommy Hilfiger Men's Black Watch

Stainless steel case and leather strap

$47.50 $95.00 50% off

A hot deal for this accessible luxury piece, the quartz movement keeps accurate time, while 30-meter water resistance protects against splashes.

Designed with a 45mm stainless steel case, black dial and black leather strap with crisp white accents, it delivers a polished look that works for everyday wear or dressier occasions. It also includes a two-year limited warranty and arrives gift-boxed. Classic never goes out of style, and this Tommy Hilfiger watch proves why.

CLASSIC TIMEPIECE

Michael Kors Corey Women's Watch

Classic three-hand watch

$100.00 $200.00 50% off

Everywhere you look on this watch, there’s an intentional detail, like the MK embossing on the dial.

This Michael Kors Corey watch is a timeless look with modern features, such as its black sunray dial, gold-tone stainless steel case and black leather strap. The 38mm case offers a versatile size for everyday wear, while quartz movement ensures reliable timekeeping. Water resistant to 30 meters, it’s built to handle daily splashes and comes backed by a two-year international limited warranty for added peace of mind.

BOXY FIT

Cotton On Tupac Men's T-Shirt

Sizes 2XS-L

$29.99 $49.99 40% off

In the week’s leading up to the 30th anniversary of his death, Macy’s is honoring Tupac Shakur with a graphic tee.

Band and music-inspired tees continue to dominate casual wardrobes, and this Cotton On Tupac shirt pays tribute to the legendary rapper with a Me Against the World graphic on a faded slate backdrop. Made from 100% cotton with a relaxed box fit and available in sizes 2XS-L, it delivers an intentionally oversized, vintage-inspired look.

VINTAGE-INSPIRED

The Sak Lanie Crochet Tote Bag

Handmade piece

$77.40 $129.00 40% off

Crochet bags are one of this summer’s biggest handbag trends, with Prada spearheading the fad. We also saw fruit prints having a micro-trend moment earlier this summer, too.

Combine this summer’s crochet and fruit fads with The Sak’s Lanie crochet tote. This hand-crocheted bag is made from yarn and come with a roomy zippered interior and both top handles and an adjustable crossbody strap. Measuring 12 by 15 inches, it’s spacious enough for everyday essentials while maintaining an effortless warm-weather aesthetic.

BAND TEE

Men's Journey Band 1981 Graphic T-Shirt

Sizes M-2XL

$23.70 $39.50 40% off

Hot take: Everyone has a Journey band tee. No? Well, this one is available for 40% off at Macy’s.

Journey merchandise continues to resonate with longtime fans and younger generations alike, thanks in part to Don’t Stop Believin’ finding a wider audience through The Sopranos finale and later Glee . This Lucky Brand graphic tee features an oversized Journey 1981 print on a classic-fit silhouette with a comfortable crewneck. Available in men’s sizes M-2XL, the cotton-blend shirt is an easy everyday staple for rock fans.

NOISE CANCELING

Baseus Wireless Headphones

Available in three colorways

$47.99 $59.99 20% off

For under $50, the Baseus Bass BH1 NC packs premium features usually found in pricier headphones.

Adaptive hybrid active noise cancellation reduces up to 45dB of background noise, while LDAC Hi-Res audio delivers more detailed wireless sound on compatible devices. The on-ear headphones come with up to 80 hours of battery life (55 with ANC enabled), memory foam ear cushions and three color options: black, pink and starlight off-white.

MACY'S EXCLUSIVE

The Rolling Stones Graphic T-Shirt

Sizes 2XS-XL

$14.75 $29.50 50% off

The Rolling Stones’ iconic tongue-and-lips logo has remained one of music’s most recognizable graphics for decades.

This Macy’s-exclusive band tee has a soft cotton-blend fabric and a classic crewneck silhouette. Available in women’s sizes 2XS-XL, the tee pairs effortlessly with denim, shorts or a slip skirt for an off-duty look.

THE BEATLES BAND TEE

The Beatles 'Strawberry Fields Forever' Women's T-Shirt

Sizes XS-XL

$8.99 $24.00 63% off

You may have to wait until 2028 for Sam Mendes’ ambitious four-part Beatles film series, but this vintage-inspired tee lets fans celebrate the band’s 1967 hit now.

Featuring a light green mineral-wash finish and strawberry artwork inspired by Strawberry Fields Forever , the soft cotton-blend shirt nods to one of The Beatles ‘ most influential songs. Available in women’s sizes XS-XL.

SELLING FAST

Gemstones Infinity Bluetooth Speaker

Comes with carrying handle

$89.99 $99.99 10% off

Bring the party anywhere with sound and a light show.

The Gemstones Infinity Bluetooth mid speaker boasts up to 24 hours of battery life that keeps playlists going from day to night. An easily portable speaker , its built-in handle allows for carrying to the beach or park during summer events. The standout “infinity mirror” display features six customizable light shows, and the speaker can pair with up to 50 compatible Infinity speakers for synchronized sound and lighting.

SPORTS EARBUDS

Baseus Wireless Open Earbuds

Available in black or white

$55.99 $79.99 30% off

If traditional in-ear earbuds tend to feel uncomfortable, the Baseus Bowie MC1 offers open-ear earphones with a clip-on design that lets you hear your surroundings while listening to music or on a call.
